name: Ankalar
source:
Ankalar – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Ankalar is an adult red-eyed red-edged nearly black om'verai. Ankalar wears a tie on his neck, has 'S'-shaped head black horns and white big back black spikes, belly covered with black plates.
"A born actor, great potion maker and an interesting speaker - Master Ankalar" - Azaries. Ankalar is a charismatic om'verai, adored by Azaries. Good in acting, is "funny" (as Azaries does think) and is very hard-working.
